voices.NARRATOR: calm, polished corporate-propaganda narrator, warm and reassuring (clean, not radio)
voices.SENSOR: sensor officer / flight control, female, tense (radio)
voices.PILOT: RX-H1 Gundam pilot, young male, determined (radio)
voices.WING: frigate / interceptor squadron lead, male, fast and excited (radio)

lines.text: [softly] We all dream of a place to call home.
lines.ko: 우리 모두는 집이라 부를 곳을 꿈꿉니다.

lines.text: For forty-one years, we crossed the dark... carrying the last of our people.
lines.ko: 41년 동안, 우리는 어둠을 건넜습니다… 마지막 남은 우리 민족을 싣고.

lines.text: [proudly] The Kharak-Sajuuk. Our city among the stars.
Hyperspace exit complete. All ships accounted for.
lines.ko: 하이퍼스페이스 이탈 완료. 전 함선 이상 없음.

lines.text: [quietly, amazed] Home... It's really there.
[warmly] Rest easy. You are home. And together, we will finally-
lines.ko: 편히 쉬십시오. 당신은 집에 왔습니다. 그리고 함께, 우리는 마침내—

lines.text: [panicked] Gravity spike, dead ahead! We can't jump!
lines.ko: 전방 중력 급상승! 도약할 수 없습니다!

lines.text: [tense] That's no star... It's a trap.
[fearful] Dreadnought class... God, it's enormous.
[commanding] All ships, battle line. Ion frigates, charge your cannons.
lines.ko: 전 함, 전열 형성. 이온 프리깃, 캐논 충전.

lines.text: Charged and locked! Ready to fire!
lines.ko: 충전 완료, 조준 고정! 사격 준비!

lines.text: [yelling] FIRE!
[excited] Target destroyed! New primary, frigate two!
[shouting] Bandits everywhere! Break left, break left!
lines.ko: 적기 사방에! 좌측 회피, 좌측 회피!

lines.text: [urgent] Port shields at forty percent!
[determined, shouting] RX-H1, launching!
[shouting] Above me-!
[panicked] Massive energy build-up on the dreadnought! It's targeting the mothership!
lines.ko: 드레드노트에 초고에너지 반응! 모선을 노리고 있습니다!

lines.text: [grimly] We can't evade. All decks, brace for impact!
lines.ko: 회피 불가. 전 구획, 충격에 대비하라!

lines.text: [coughing] Damage report... somebody talk to me.
[shaken] Thirty-two percent of the hull is gone. If that well stays up... we all die here.
lines.ko: 선체 32퍼센트 소실. 저 우물이 버티는 한… 우린 여기서 전멸합니다.

lines.text: [quietly] ...I'm going in.
[desperate] RX-H1, pull back! Past that line, time itself bends!
lines.ko: RX-H1, 물러나! 그 선을 넘으면 시간 자체가 휘어진다!

lines.text: [breathing heavily] My clock's... slowing down. It's okay. I can still see it.
lines.ko: 시계가… 느려지고 있어. 괜찮아. 아직 보여.

lines.text: Output to maximum. Limiters... off.
[screaming] THIS ENDS NOW!
[astonished] The well... it's gone!
[fiercely] Bring us about. Every drop of power to the main gun.
[roaring] FIRE!
[cheering] Dreadnought is breaking apart!
Enemy survivors are jumping out. They're running.
[worried, softly] RX-H1... respond. RX-H1, do you copy?
[weak, exhausted] ...This is RX-H1. I'm... coming home.
[warmly, emotional] All ships... take us home.
[softly] We all dream of a home.
Some of us... have to fight for it.
lines.ko: 어떤 이들은… 그것을 위해 싸워야 하죠.
